Package database

Class CourseRegistry

java.lang.Object
database.CourseRegistry
All Implemented Interfaces:
Serializable
public class CourseRegistry extends Object implements Serializable
Singleton registry for courses and teacher assignments. Supports serialization so course enrollment data persists between sessions.
